repository_validation.attestation_scope: Verified repository code, contracts, package integrity, official Plugin validation, tests, managed profile lifecycle, and removal of CHANGELOG_V3.md, PRIVACY.md, TERMS.md, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Third-party MIT attribution remains preserved in LICENSE and the derived source points to it. The resulting status-only exact head still requires the final CI regression run.

release_rule: V4.0.0 publication requires the exact candidate to pass repository validation, the candidate-bound N0-N8 Host campaign, fresh exact-candidate Final Review, external release evidence verification, installed-product checks, and human two-Skill App observation. Host capability feasibility evidence is pre-release design evidence only. PENDING or UNKNOWN is not PASS.
